boxes.note: A corrected form REPLACES the one it corrects for the same account: the two are never both counted. Which copy stands is a person's call, made by reading the two side by side.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.note: Printed on Copy A (the IRS's copy) only; a recipient's copy carries no VOID box. Declared so a Copy A that reaches the packet is recognised for what it is - a form that reports nothing.

boxes.label: Service Provider/Acct. No. (see instr.)
boxes.note: The service provider's or institution's account number for the student - what tells two of one filer's forms apart.

boxes.label: STUDENT'S name
boxes.note: Whose credit: the education credit is claimed by whoever claims this student.

document.notes: Boxes 2 and 3 are reserved: the Instructions for Forms 1098-E and 1098-T (2025) say of each 'This box is reserved for future use.' This document is declared here for its boxes only. Its ROUTING - to Form 8863 (American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning credits) and to the tuition provisions - belongs to the education-credits part of this map and is deliberately not duplicated here. Note the deduction/credit trap: box 1 must be reduced by box 5 scholarships before it supports any education benefit, and box 7 warns that box 1 may include a term that falls in the NEXT tax year.
